// This file isn't part of pairtime's build; the .txt suffix keeps the Go
// toolchain away from it. extract.sh copies it into gitleaks' own
// cmd/generate/config/utils package and calls pairtimeDump at the top of
// Validate and ValidateWithPaths, so every true and false positive gitleaks
// checks its rules against is written out, with the secrets gitleaks' own
// detector finds in it.

package utils

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"sort"

	"github.com/zricethezav/gitleaks/v8/config"
	"github.com/zricethezav/gitleaks/v8/detect"
)

// extract.sh gzips the corpus, so secret scanners don't take its samples
// for leaked keys.
type pairtimeSample struct {
	Text    string   `json:"text"`
	Path    string   `json:"path,omitempty"`
	Secrets []string `json:"secrets"`
}

type pairtimeCase struct {
	Rule string           `json:"rule"`
	TPs  []pairtimeSample `json:"tps"`
	FPs  []pairtimeSample `json:"fps"`
}

func pairtimeSamples(rule config.Rule, texts []string, paths map[string]string) []pairtimeSample {
	samples := []pairtimeSample{}
	add := func(text, path string) {
		r := rule
		d := createSingleRuleDetector(&r)
		s := pairtimeSample{Text: text, Path: path, Secrets: []string{}}
		for _, f := range d.Detect(detect.Fragment{Raw: text, FilePath: path}) {
			s.Secrets = append(s.Secrets, f.Secret)
		}
		samples = append(samples, s)
	}
	for _, t := range texts {
		add(t, "")
	}
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(paths))
	for p := range paths {
		keys = append(keys, p)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)
	for _, p := range keys {
		add(paths[p], p)
	}
	return samples
}

func pairtimeDump(rule config.Rule, tps, fps []string, pathTPs, pathFPs map[string]string) {
	out := os.Getenv("PAIRTIME_GITLEAKS_DUMP")
	if out == "" {
		return
	}
	line, err := json.Marshal(pairtimeCase{
		Rule: rule.RuleID,
		TPs:  pairtimeSamples(rule, tps, pathTPs),
		FPs:  pairtimeSamples(rule, fps, pathFPs),
	})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	f, err := os.OpenFile(out, os.O_APPEND|os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY, 0o644)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if _, err := f.Write(append(line, '\n')); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := f.Close(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
